payload.text: Issue 0732 (filed e0ac914cb, vc 16:31Z), ic's, in ST0095 WP-10 Part 2, rides this release: Facade::day_of_event folds a store read failure into IdRecord.created = None (cc ruled it a silent error; WP-07 lands with it only as this issue). Make record_of return a Result so id_of carries a typed error; keep None only for an event the log does not hold.
